requirement: Alarm can be enabled and disabled independently
Voice can be enabled and disabled independently
Alarm ON plus Voice OFF produces normal alarm with no speech
Alarm OFF plus Voice ON produces speech with no normal alarm
Alarm ON plus Voice ON produces alarm and spoken reminder
Reminder popup shows medicine dose date time frequency timing food duration and route when available
Medicines due within the same minute appear in one grouped popup
Grouped medicines are spoken sequentially without overlapping
Taken on one medicine handles only that medicine
Snooze on one medicine schedules it again 10 minutes later
Skip on one medicine handles only that medicine
Taken all handles every medicine in the reminder group
Snooze all snoozes every medicine for 10 minutes
Skip all handles every medicine in the reminder group
Repeat this medicine and Repeat all medicines replay the correct speech
The same event and same due time does not create duplicate reminder sessions
